title: ResolvedCoordinatorInvocation
description: The route-bearing entry point. run_type is required and human-supplied; there is no model route classifier (decision D3, §14.3.1).

observedComponentTreeRef.description: A reference and a hash, never inline content (§14.3.21). The full tree is preserved externally and immutably; models receive bounded provenance-linked excerpts prepared by deterministic code (§5.4).

run_type.description: Required. An absent or invalid route blocks before any model invocation.

expected_ref_classes.description: Advisory only; the deterministic planner may widen or narrow it.

allOf.description: modify and audit require a target component reference. `properties` is restated inside `then` because Ajv strict mode requires a `required` property to be declared in the same subschema scope.
new builds from scratch, so a target is not merely unnecessary — it contradicts the route.
